title: Handling a remove operation on a Group
desc: A decision on what a PATCH remove carries, matching the op without regard to case because Entra sends Remove. A remove with no path is a 400 noTarget. A remove whose path is members with a filter on one value, the form Okta sends, removes that member. A remove whose path is members with the ids in a value list, Entra's form, is outside what RFC 7644 specifies: honour the ids in value. A remove whose path is members with no value is the RFC's path-only rule and empties the group, so decide which clients may reach it.
